explication: Juice Shop is an intentionally vulnerable online shop designed for security training, awareness demonstrations and CTF play. A user browses the Angular client, interacts with shop and account features through the Express API, and can pursue security challenges whose progress is surfaced on the scoreboard. The tree also documents coding challenges, a chatbot, and Web3 features. The sampled server code confirms selected endpoint dispatch and startup data creation; unsampled route internals and most client-to-server wiring are not expanded here.
